items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Faiso, Shawnee, Red Haffer. Well, I was in that reading class. Me, Cantrell, and Alfred Williams.

ctx.x: Who were some of your favorite drummers?

Faiso, Shawnee, Red Haffer. Well, I was in that reading class. Me, Cantrell, and Alfred Williams. That was a nice orchestra drummer. Good reader, huh? I don't know about his reading ability, but I know for playing track drummer, he played nice snare drum, he had a nice sweep. That Sam Morgan band had a nice sweep. They didn't play too loud. He had a nice, nice band. He played nice drum, kept nice time. He was none of them felt. He made his explosion and he kept right at his time. That's what he did. Well, I was a…
That's when your foot you'd make those accents.
